summary.text: Peggy Mayfield is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 60, which she has represented since November 2012, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Carrie Syczylo as her opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Peggy Mayfield earned a certificate in computer technology from Indiana University-Purdue University Indianapolis.

Ballotpedia, quoting her 2014 campaign website, says she and her husband own Mayfield Insurance, Inc., and that she previously served as a county clerk and as an executive board member of the Association of Clerks of Circuit Courts of Indiana.
Mayfield took office in the Indiana House on November 7, 2012.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the Insurance and Ways and Means committees and as vice chair of the House Public Policy Committee.
